decisions.reason: The source decision concerns replacement of tutorial images in the iOS version and does not necessarily change the Android localized-tutorial asset strategy.
The impact is already fully represented by the existing message-193 MODIFY, which changes the iOS tutorial format to YouTube video and removes the obsolete tutorial-image strategy.
Replacing tutorial images with a YouTube video does not change the required iOS localization scale or App Store language coverage.
The tutorial-media replacement does not alter the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The source decision changes tutorial media assets, not the iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
Replacing tutorial images with a YouTube video does not remove or modify the App Store privacy-manifest requirement.
The iOS tutorial-media replacement does not change Android full-app localization or its 77-language coverage.
The tutorial-media replacement has no effect on the validity of the iOS signing configuration.
The source decision is about iOS tutorial media and does not alter Android platform modernization requirements.
Tutorial-media replacement does not affect the Android policy requiring removal of unused permissions.
The source specifically replaces tutorial images and does not cancel or modify cleanup of application-skin graphics.
Replacing tutorial images with a YouTube video does not change the separate iPad layout problem.
